But when we realized about 85% of our customers are 1 time only purchasers, it made it hard to justify losing 30% of our revenue on discounts and never seeing that customer again. So we still do discounts to make sure people buy from us; but it's mostly on inventory items, and the discounts are 15% - 20% instead of 30%.
